# Piñata

> A group gift list that lives in a WhatsApp group. The person getting the gift keeps a wish list; their friends claim gifts or pool money behind one buyer, and the list owner never sees those plans.

- Site: https://gifts.scholtz.work/
- Privacy notice: https://gifts.scholtz.work/privacy
- How-to guide: https://gifts.scholtz.work/guide
- Status: opening circles in small batches; sign up on the home page for a setup link, or use the contact form.
- Money: Piñata holds no money; friends pay each other directly. Prices default to US dollars, with rand, euro or pounds per gift.
